content.text:
Based on my review of all changed files:

**File-by-file analysis:**

1. **`app/[locale]/sitemap/[town]/[year]/[month]/page.tsx`** — Refactor to parallelize two already-existing fetch calls via `Promise.all`. The `town` param is validated (`isValidPlace(town)`) before use. `.catch(() => null)` is still applied to the place lookup so failures don't reject the Promise.all. Error semantics preserved.

2. **`components/partials/generatePagesData.ts`** — Pure type refactor: replaced inline `Omit<GeneratePagesDataProps, "search"> & { placeTypeLabel: ...; locale?: ... }` with named types `GeneratePagesDataCachedProps` / `GeneratePagesDataPublicProps`. Effective type shape is unchanged.

3. **`lib/api/categories.ts`** — Replaced hardcoded `"categories"` string with the `categoriesTag` constant (already imported). Verified `categoriesTag = "categories"` — identical value, no regression to the cache-tag registry.

4. **`lib/seo/place-expandability.ts`** — Replaced `encodeURIComponent(slug)` interpolation with `buildEventsQuery({ place: slug, size: 1 })` (which uses `URLSearchParams`). Both properly encode reserved characters; no injection or SSRF regression. Query semantics identical (`place=<slug>&size=1`).

5. **`test/place-expandability.test.ts`** — Test-only change; using `importActual` to keep other helpers real while mocking two functions. No production impact.

6. **`types/common.ts`** — Added two exported interfaces; the `Omit<..., "search" | "placeTypeLabel">` + re-adding `placeTypeLabel` as required matches the prior inline intersection. No shape change.

No sinks reached (no shell, SQL, HTML render, deserialization). No new attacker-controlled data flow. No auth/gate changes. No allowlist/registry drift. No fail-open state drift. No sensitive-to-observability leaks. This changeset is a performance/typing/consistency cleanup with equivalent behavior.
